description: Header file declaring the google_breakpad::DumpSymbols class for reading and dumping debugging symbols from Mach-O files and bundles, including methods for setting architecture, reading symbol data, and writing symbol files.

classes.name: DumpSymbols
classes.description: A class for reading debugging information from Mach-O files, bundles, or universal binaries, and writing out symbol data.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Prepares to read debugging information from a specified filename, which can be a binary, Mach-O, or dSYM bundle.

methods.name: SetArchitecture
methods.description: Selects an object file for dumping based on CPU type/subtype or architecture name.

methods.name: AvailableArchitectures
methods.description: Returns an array of available architectures within the file.

methods.name: WriteSymbolFile
methods.description: Writes the debugging symbols to an output stream.

methods.name: ReadSymbolData
methods.description: Returns debugging information as a Module object.
